messages:
jun: Heads-up — uploads service is returning intermittent 503s for small batches since 09:10 UTC. I have a patch that fixes a race in the chunked writer. Patch built as `v1.2.3-railgun-hotfix` and smoke passed locally. Need expedited approval to push and skip full canary (we'll do staged traffic 10% -> 50% -> 100%).

mike: Can you paste the deploy command and the rollout plan?

jun: Deploy command: `./deploy --service uploads --image redwood/uploads:v1.2.3-railgun-hotfix --rollout staged`
Rollout plan: 10% 3m -> 50% 5m -> 100%. If errors spike we abort to `v1.2.0`.

deploy-bot: @channel deploy request received for uploads from jun. Details: image=redwood/uploads:v1.2.3-railgun-hotfix, env=prod, requested_skip_canary=true. Link: https://deploy.redwood.internal/rollouts/4987659999 :rocket:

sarah: Is this safe to skip canary entirely? I'd prefer to keep low-volume canary but if staging-split is quick i'm OK.

jun: Not skipping entirely — just skipping the long 30m canary. We'll do automated probes at each step and k/v cache warm-up. Metrics to watch: 503 rate, p50 latency, error_budget.

raj: How do we detect rollback? What log signal will trigger abort?

jun: We'll abort if 503 rate > 0.5% for 3 consecutive minutes or p50 latency +20% over baseline. Deploy-bot will auto-abort and pin back to `v1.2.0`.

kevin: I can approve but want opt-in from SRE on-call first. @emma are you oncall?

emma: Oncall. I reviewed the changelist and it looks minimal. Approve from me but will watch first two minutes closely. :eyes:

mike: +1 from me. This is a small fix and we've seen the race in staging.

deploy-bot: approvals: kevin (pending), emma (approved), mike (approved), raj (none)

kevin: Approving now. Go ahead jun. :thumbsup:

jun: Kicking off deploy. Starting staged rollout at 10%.

deploy-bot: rollout started: uploads -> redwood/uploads:v1.2.3-railgun-hotfix
step 1: 10% traffic (0m)

emma: Watching metrics. No spike so far. 503s down to 0.02% from 0.5%.

jun: Moving to 50% in 2m.

deploy-bot: step 2: 50% traffic (2m) — health checks OK.

mike: Looks clean.

raj: Quick note — we saw a tiny blip in one AZ around 50% but it resolved and wasn't correlated with the patch trace.

jun: Proceeding to 100% now.

deploy-bot: step 3: 100% traffic — rollout complete. 503s at 0.01% and p50 latency stable. Rollout marked success. :tada:

emma: Thanks team — will keep an eye on nocturnal metrics, but I'm comfortable closing this.

jun: I'll prepare a short release note and link the PR. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/uploads/pull/492 — includes changelog and root-cause summary.

mike: Can we add a short postmortem note to the weekly deploy notes? Even if low impact.

jun: Yep adding now.

deploy-bot: deploy 4987659999 archived. pinned-version: redwood/uploads:v1.2.3-railgun-hotfix.
